name: Odeme: para alma, bakiye, taksit odeme ve odeme silince taksidin acilmasi
description: TEST hastasinda 100.000 formatli tutar girisi, bakiye tutarliligi ve taksit-odeme baglantisi.

planSteps.description: Log in with the TEST account credentials configured for this project
Open patient 'TEST Senaryo HASTA' and go to the 'Hesap' tab; note the remaining balance
Click the add payment button, choose cash, and type the amount 12500 in the amount field
Verify the amount field automatically shows the value as 12.500 with a dot as thousands separator
Verify the payment of 12.500,00 appears in the payment history and the remaining balance decreased by exactly 12.500,00
Create an installment plan for the remaining balance with 3 installments
Verify the three installment amounts add up exactly to the remaining balance
Mark the first installment as paid
Verify a new payment named 'Taksit odemesi' appears in the payment history and the balance decreased by that installment amount
Delete that installment payment from the payment history
Verify the first installment is shown as unpaid again and the balance is back to its previous value
